verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS remote-access and endpoint-management product, so the axis applies. However, the pack contains no documented feature for exporting all user data in open formats. The Web API and the 'audit log and API' listing are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
